observed_handles.claims: On-screen evidence, not account proof: the PSN names Madden showed in this recorded video, read by QorCap from the player banners. Sony and EA offer no public login or API, and a name on screen does not show who held the controller.

notes: side corrected after recording: QorCap was set to home, signed as away (on-screen PSN banners: recorder owner Qortrola30 (QOR) is on the left/away side; Everything_360 (EVE) is home); checkpoints and challenges keep the recorded side home

input.claims: Shows these inputs came from the USB-connected controller in sync with this video. It does not show who was holding the controller.
